Quelque 1.800 personnes ont été interpellées dans le cadre des violences et pillages commis en France samedi 17 octobre et jusque dans la nuit, a indiqué dimanche le ministre de l'Intérieur Laurent Nuñez, qui se rendra à Marseille lundi.

Laurent Nuñez se rendra lundi à Marseille, où samedi "des exactions (ont été) commises par plusieurs milliers d'individus d'ultragauche", ensuite "rejoints par des délinquants qui ont pillé et saccagé de nombreux commerces".
À Paris, plus de 500 personnes sont en garde à vue ce dimanche, a indiqué le parquet de la capitale dans un bilan « pas encore consolidé ».
Les forces de l’ordre avaient interpellé « 855 » personnes samedi à Paris, un « chiffre record », a annoncé dimanche la préfecture de police (PP) dans un bilan à 08 h 00.

Interior Minister Laurent Nunez said 1,800 people were arrested over the protests and looting, with investigations under way “to identify the perpetrators of these acts so they can be brought to justice”.
Around 500 police, firefighters and paramedics were hurt in the protests, the interior minister said.
The violence took place on the sidelines of nationwide protests that the interior ministry said were attended by 550,000 people.
The CGT union said 800,000 people participated.
Le ministre de l'Intérieur annonce 400 interpellations dans toute la France
France's General Confederation of Labour (CGT) has said almost 800,000 people have participated in the protests across the country today.
France's interior minister, Laurent Nuñez, has given an update stating around 400 people were arrested.
Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez said in televised update that around 550,000 people participated in demonstrations across France today.
People close to Interior Minister Laurent Nuñez say that roughly 32,800 people had taken part in 140 protests across the country already.

S'exprimant devant la presse, le ministre de l'Intérieur, qui a dénombré 110 défilés samedi, a fait valoir qu'en marge des cortèges, s'étaient constitués «des groupes de casseurs - plusieurs centaines, plusieurs milliers parfois selon les lieux - à l'instigation très claire de l'ultragauche» .

Some 1,200 people had been arrested by Sunday morning in what government officials are calling an "escalation in violence" after approximately 550,000 people, including Yellow Vest activists, joined student demonstrators in Paris, Marseille, Rennes and Toulouse, according to the interior ministry.
Prime Minister Sebastien Lecornu said more than 900 police officers had also been injured in previous protests.
